import sys

def solve():
    data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    if not data:
        return
    n = int(data[0])
    m = int(data[1])
    l = int(data[2])
    r = int(data[3])
    k = n * m
    length = r - l + 1
    mod = 998244353

    if k % 2 == 1:
        ans = pow(length, k, mod)
    else:
        ans = (pow(length, k, mod) + pow(length % 2, k, mod)) * pow(2, mod - 2, mod) % mod
    print(ans)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    solve()
